battery.addHelp: Pick a battery sensor and it joins the list. One already in the list is not offered again, and a sensor published without the battery device class is not offered at all; that one still works if you add it in YAML.
battery.chargingHelp: A binary sensor that is on while this device is charging. Only needed when the battery sensor does not report it itself.
battery.description: A Cupertino-style battery widget for the devices you care about.
battery.editorEmpty: No devices yet. The card will say so too.
battery.iconHelp: Says which device this is; the ring already says the level.
battery.name: Cupertino Batteries
battery.nameHelp: The tooltip and the screen-reader label. The card never draws it.

calendar.calendarsHelp: Leave empty to show every calendar.
calendar.clockHelp: System follows your Home Assistant time format. Pick one to override it.
calendar.description: A Cupertino-style calendar widget for your dashboard.
calendar.firstDayHelp: Counted from today: 1 is tomorrow, -1 is yesterday, 0 stays on today.
calendar.name: Cupertino Calendar
calendar.remindersHelp: Draw to-do items that have a due date alongside your events.
calendar.singleColumnHelp: Automatic uses one column in a large, near-square card. Off keeps the usual layout.
calendar.todoListsHelp: Leave empty to read every to-do list.

clock.description: Show the time with optional weather and up to four complications.
clock.name: Cupertino Clock
clock.trackingHelp: Space between digits in thousandths of an em.

common.blocklistHelp: Enter words or phrases separated by commas, e.g. lunch, school run. Titles containing any entry are hidden in this card only, ignoring case. Leave empty to show everything.
common.scaleHelp: Draws the whole widget larger or smaller: type, rows and spacing together. Fewer rows fit as it grows, so give a scaled-up card more height in the Layout tab.

complications.addHelp: Choose an entity to add a complication.
complications.caption: Caption
complications.description: Read multiple entities in rings, dials and discs.
complications.name: Cupertino Complications

controls.areasHelp: Leave blank for the entire home.
controls.capacity: Estimated visible tiles at the configured Layout and Scale: {{capacity}}.
controls.choose: Choose entities in the card editor.
controls.description: Control an ordered set of Home Assistant entities.
controls.hidden: {{hint}} Pinned tiles beyond this limit are hidden.
controls.name: Cupertino Controls

reminders.colourHelp: Kept on the list itself, so every widget showing it agrees.
reminders.description: A Cupertino-style widget for one of your to-do lists.
reminders.listHelp: The to-do list this widget draws. Add another card for another list.
reminders.name: Cupertino Reminders
